* Fixed assumptions for the example monthly cost: 100 calls/day · 2,000 input / 800 output tokens per call · off-peak rates · 30% cache hit rate · 30-day month — the same formula and defaults as the cost calculator. USD models are converted to CNY at the reference rate for comparison (see summary). Costs within display precision are marked tied; neither side is favored.

Comparison summary (fixed usage basis)

  • Estimated monthly cost: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite ¥31.54 vs GLM-5.3 ¥104.40 on a common CNY basis (list prices $4.69 / ¥104.40) — at this fixed usage, Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is cheaper by ¥72.86/month.
  • Cost ratio: under this basis, GLM-5.3 costs about 3.3× Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is ~70% cheaper). The ratio holds only at the current list prices, reference rate and fixed usage assumptions; it says nothing about capability, output quality or overall value.
  • Input unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $0.25 vs ¥8; after conversion Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is lower (by ≈ ¥6.32/1M tokens).
  • Output unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $1.5 vs ¥28; after conversion Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is lower (by ≈ ¥17.92/1M tokens).
  • Cache-hit price (off-peak basis): Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite $0.025; GLM-5.3 ¥2.
  • Currencies: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is billed in USD, GLM-5.3 in CNY; conversion uses the CFETS central parity rate (see above) and is indicative only.
  • Context window: identical at 1024K.
  • Modalities: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite=Text, Image understanding, Video understanding; GLM-5.3=Text (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite adds Image understanding, Video understanding).
  • Price sources: Google AI pricing (verified 2026-10-28), Alibaba Cloud Model Studio — GLM-5.3 model page (verified 2026-10-28); unit: official list price per 1M tokens (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite in USD, GLM-5.3 in CNY; cross-currency figures converted to CNY as noted above).

These are computations from published list prices under fixed call volume, token usage, cache assumptions and billing rules. They are not rankings of capability, output quality or overall value, and do not constitute purchase advice.
